title: Seasons
summary: Name the four seasons, say which one you prefer, and describe what the weather is usually like with يَكُونُ.
intro: Today you learn the four seasons: الرَّبِيع (spring), الصَّيْف (summer), الْخَرِيف (autumn) and الشِّتَاء (winter). To say what the weather is usually like, use يَكُونُ (is, is usually), the present form of كَانَ. Like كَانَ, it puts the describing word in the -an form: فِي الصَّيْف يَكُونُ الْجَوّ حَارًّا (in summer the weather is hot).
objectives: Name the four seasons in Arabic
Say what the weather is usually like with يَكُونُ
Say which season you prefer with أُفَضِّلُ
Ask a friend: مَا فَصْلُكَ الْمُفَضَّل؟

realLife.title: Four seasons, three countries
realLife.story: In Tuesday's class Mr Karim brings four photos: a green hillside, a beach, a tree with red leaves and a snowy mountain. Layla, Sami and Daniel each describe the seasons back home, and everyone learns something surprising about the others' countries.

sentences.en: In summer the weather is hot.
sentences.literal: in the summer is (usually) the weather hot

mistakes.why: After yakūnu, as after kāna, the describing word takes the -an ending: ḥārran.

sentences.en: What's your favourite season? (to a man)

mistakes.why: faṣluka (your season) is definite, so the adjective after it needs al-: al-mufaḍḍal.

sentences.literal: I-prefer the autumn over the summer

sentences.en: Winter will be cold in Amman.
sentences.literal: will-be the winter cold in Amman

sentences.en: Sometimes snow falls on the mountains.
sentences.literal: sometimes comes-down the snow on the mountains

dialogue.title: My favourite season
dialogue.culture: Egypt has a long, hot summer and a short, mild winter. In spring, hot winds called الْخَمَاسِين blow in from the desert, bringing sand and dust; the name comes from the word for fifty, because they can come at any time in about fifty days. Lebanon is famous for having snowy mountains only an hour from the sea.

lines.ar: الْيَوْمَ سَنَتَكَلَّمُ عَنْ فُصُولِ السَّنَة: الرَّبِيع وَالصَّيْف وَالْخَرِيف وَالشِّتَاء. مَا فَصْلُكِ الْمُفَضَّل يَا لَيْلَى؟
lines.en: Today we'll talk about the seasons of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter. What's your favourite season, Layla?

lines.ar: أُحِبُّ الرَّبِيع كَثِيرًا. فِي لُبْنَان يَكُونُ الْجَوّ مُعْتَدِلًا فِي الرَّبِيع، وَالْجِبَال خَضْرَاء وَجَمِيلَة.
lines.en: I love spring very much. In Lebanon the weather is usually mild in spring, and the mountains are green and beautiful.

lines.ar: وَهَلْ يَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج فِي لُبْنَان؟ كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاس لَا يَعْرِفُونَ ذٰلِكَ.
lines.en: And does it snow in Lebanon? A lot of people don't know that, you know.

lines.ar: نَعَم، فِي الشِّتَاء يَنْزِلُ الثَّلْج عَلَى الْجِبَال. وَفِي الرَّبِيع نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَتَزَلَّجَ صَبَاحًا وَنَسْبَحَ فِي الْبَحْر مَسَاءً!
lines.en: Yes, in winter snow falls on the mountains. And in spring we can ski in the morning and swim in the sea in the evening!

lines.ar: هٰذَا رَائِع! فِي شِيكَاغُو الشِّتَاء طَوِيل وَبَارِد جِدًّا، وَأَحْيَانًا تَكُونُ الْحَرَارَة عِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً تَحْتَ الصِّفْر.
lines.en: That's amazing! In Chicago winter is long and very cold, and sometimes the temperature is twenty degrees below zero.

lines.ar: عِشْرُونَ تَحْتَ الصِّفْر؟ لَا، شُكْرًا! أَنَا لَنْ أُسَافِرَ إِلَى شِيكَاغُو فِي الشِّتَاء أَبَدًا!
lines.en: Twenty below zero? No, thank you! I will never travel to Chicago in winter!

lines.ar: وَأَنْتَ يَا دَانْيَال، مَا فَصْلُكَ الْمُفَضَّل؟ الشِّتَاء طَبْعًا، لِأَنَّكَ تُحِبُّ الثَّلْج!
lines.en: And you, Daniel, what's your favourite season? Winter, of course, because you love the snow!

lines.ar: لَا، أُفَضِّلُ الْخَرِيف! فِي الْخَرِيف تَكُونُ الْأَشْجَار حَمْرَاءَ وَصَفْرَاءَ، وَالْجَوّ لَيْسَ حَارًّا وَلَا بَارِدًا.
lines.en: No, I prefer autumn! In autumn the trees are red and yellow, and the weather is neither hot nor cold.

lines.ar: وَأَنْتَ يَا سَامِي؟ فِي مِصْر يَكُونُ الصَّيْف طَوِيلًا وَحَارًّا، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟
lines.en: And you, Sami? In Egypt the summer is long and hot, isn't it?

lines.ar: صَحِيح، فِي الصَّيْف تَكُونُ الْحَرَارَة أَحْيَانًا أَرْبَعِينَ دَرَجَةً. لِذٰلِكَ أُفَضِّلُ الشِّتَاء، فَهُوَ مُعْتَدِل وَلَطِيف هُنَا.
lines.en: That's right: in summer the temperature is sometimes forty degrees. That's why I prefer winter; it's mild and pleasant here.

lines.ar: وَمَاذَا عَنِ الرَّبِيع فِي مِصْر؟ هَلْ تَكُونُ هُنَاكَ رِيَاح قَوِيَّة؟ سَمِعْتُ عَنْ ذٰلِكَ.
lines.en: And what about spring in Egypt? Are there strong winds then? I've heard about that.

lines.ar: نَعَم، فِي الرَّبِيع تَأْتِي رِيَاحُ الْخَمَاسِين مِنَ الصَّحْرَاء، وَتَكُونُ حَارَّة وَفِيهَا رَمْل كَثِير.
lines.en: Yes, in spring the khamasin winds come from the desert; they are hot and full of sand.

lines.ar: أَحْسَنْتُمْ! وَالْآنَ الْوَاجِب: اُكْتُبُوا خَمْسَ جُمَل عَنْ فَصْلِكُمُ الْمُفَضَّل، وَعَنِ الطَّقْس فِيهِ.
lines.en: Well done, everyone! Now the homework: write five sentences about your favourite season and the weather in it.

lines.ar: سَأَكْتُبُ عَنِ الْخَرِيف فِي شِيكَاغُو، وَعَنِ الْخَرِيف فِي الْقَاهِرَة أَيْضًا. هُنَا الْخَرِيف مِثْلُ الصَّيْف!
lines.en: I'll write about autumn in Chicago, and about autumn in Cairo too. Here autumn is just like summer!

reading.title: The seasons in Egypt
reading.ar: فِي مِصْر أَرْبَعَةُ فُصُول. يَكُونُ الصَّيْف حَارًّا جِدًّا، وَأَحْيَانًا تَكُونُ الْحَرَارَة أَرْبَعِينَ دَرَجَةً. الْخَرِيف دَافِئ، وَالشِّتَاء مُعْتَدِل وَلَطِيف. فِي الرَّبِيع تَأْتِي رِيَاحُ الْخَمَاسِين مِنَ الصَّحْرَاء. سَامِي يُفَضِّلُ الشِّتَاء، وَدَانْيَال يُفَضِّلُ الْخَرِيف.
reading.en: Egypt has four seasons. The summer is very hot, and sometimes the temperature is forty degrees. Autumn is warm, and winter is mild and pleasant. In spring the khamasin winds come from the desert. Sami prefers winter, and Daniel prefers autumn.

quiz.prompt: Choose the correct sentence: 'In winter the weather is cold.'

options: hot spring winds from the desert

quiz.prompt: Which season begins with kh (خ), like the ch in Scottish 'loch'?

completion: Excellent! You can name the seasons and say what the weather is usually like with يَكُونُ. Next: the months of the year.
